entry.title: Fixing the Data-Juicer Ray Config Warning
entry.content:
If you are running Data-Juicer and see the following warning repeated in your logs:

data_juicer.utils.ray_utils: No ray config provided, using default ray address 'auto'

this guide explains what the warning means, how to silence it by providing an explicit Ray configuration, and how to reduce log spam overall.

Understanding the Warning

Data-Juicer uses Ray as its distributed execution backend. When data_juicer.utils.ray_utils initialises Ray it looks for an explicit Ray address (the address of an already-running Ray head node). If none is found it falls back to the string 'auto', which tells Ray to attempt automatic cluster discovery. The warning is emitted once per call to the initialisation helper, so it can appear many times if the helper is invoked repeatedly.

Providing Ray Configuration

Via Environment Variable (RAY_ADDRESS)

The simplest way to point Data-Juicer at a specific Ray cluster is to set the RAY_ADDRESS environment variable before starting your job:

export RAY_ADDRESS="ray://127.0.0.1:10001"

Via CLI Argument

python -m data_juicer.tools.process_data \
    --config my_config.yaml \
    --ray_address "ray://127.0.0.1:10001"

Via Data-Juicer Config File

executor_type: 'ray'
ray_address: 'ray://127.0.0.1:10001'

Starting a Ray Cluster

ray start --head --port=6379
export RAY_ADDRESS="ray://127.0.0.1:10001"

Reducing Log Spam

Setting the Log Level

import logging
logging.getLogger('data_juicer.utils.ray_utils').setLevel(logging.ERROR)

Ensuring Ray is Initialized Once

import ray
if not ray.is_initialized():
    ray.init(address="ray://127.0.0.1:10001")

Troubleshooting

Warning still appears after setting RAY_ADDRESS: Make sure the variable is exported before the Python process starts.

Ray cannot connect to the head node: Check that the Ray head node is running (ray status) and that the port is reachable. Use ray://HOST:10001 for the Ray client protocol.

Multiple warnings per second: Add the ray.is_initialized() guard to prevent redundant calls.

Error: RuntimeError: Ray address is not set: Start a head node with ray start --head and set RAY_ADDRESS as described above.
entry.summary: Learn how to fix the repeated Data-Juicer warning "No ray config provided, using default ray address auto". Covers CLI, environment variables, config files, and how to reduce log spam.
